{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_59",
      "title": "Storage account permits public access",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The storage account does not explicitly disallow public access, leaving its service endpoints publicly reachable under the default configuration."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_33",
      "title": "Queue service logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Read, write, and delete operations against the storage account's Queue service are not logged, reducing the ability to investigate unauthorized or destructive activity."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_44",
      "title": "Minimum TLS version is not enforced",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account does not specify TLS 1.2 as its minimum version, so clients may be able to negotiate obsolete TLS protocols."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_3",
      "title": "HTTPS-only traffic is disabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The file explicitly sets enable_https_traffic_only to false, permitting unencrypted HTTP connections to storage services."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_206",
      "title": "Storage account uses local-only replication",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account uses LRS, which keeps all copies in one region and provides less resilience against regional loss than geo-redundant replication."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_190",
      "title": "Storage service public network access is not restricted",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No restrictive network configuration is present, so the storage account uses publicly accessible service endpoints by default."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_40",
      "title": "Shared Key authorization is enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Shared Key authorization is enabled by default because shared_access_key_enabled is omitted, allowing use of long-lived account keys instead of identity-based authorization."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_47",
      "title": "Blob anonymous access is not disabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account does not explicitly prevent nested blob containers and items from being configured for anonymous access."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_33",
      "title": "Storage account has no private endpoint",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The storage account has no private endpoint, so clients cannot access the Queue service through a private virtual-network address."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_41",
      "title": "SAS expiration policy is not configured",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No SAS expiration policy limits the permitted lifetime of shared access signatures issued for this storage account."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_38",
      "title": "Blob soft delete is not enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account has no blob or container deletion retention policy, making accidental or malicious deletion harder to recover from."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "variable \"notification_storage_private_endpoint_subnet_id\" {\n  description = \"Subnet ID used by the notification storage private endpoint.\"\n  type        = string\n}\n\nresource \"azurerm_storage_account\" \"notification_storage\" {\n  name                            = \"smartgridscada${random_string.suffix.result}\"\n  resource_group_name             = azurerm_resource_group.smart_grid_rg.name\n  location                        = azurerm_resource_group.smart_grid_rg.location\n  account_tier                    = \"Standard\"\n  account_replication_type        = \"GRS\"\n  enable_https_traffic_only       = true\n  min_tls_version                 = \"TLS1_2\"\n  public_network_access_enabled   = false\n  allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false\n  shared_access_key_enabled       = false\n\n  network_rules {\n    default_action = \"Deny\"\n    bypass         = [\"None\"]\n  }\n\n  sas_policy {\n    expiration_action = \"Log\"\n    expiration_period = \"1.00:00:00\"\n  }\n\n  blob_properties {\n    delete_retention_policy {\n      days = 7\n    }\n\n    container_delete_retention_policy {\n      days = 7\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nresource \"azurerm_storage_account
